A hotel bar that is not boring!
Mar 2026 • Solo
Forget the "sterile and boring" hotel bar stereotype—Barson has major main character energy. It's a really unusual for a hotel bar in Marriott.

The crowd is actually fun to chat with, and the cocktails are these really innovative drinks inspired by Vietnam itself. Julie, Anna, and Dino are total legends—they’re so hospitable and easy to talk to that you'll forget you're technically a tourist. If you’re in Ho Chi Minh City and want a drink that doesn't taste like a mid-life crisis, stop by here. I’m definitely going back.

Christmas is coming in BARSON
Dec 2025 • Friends
Barson has become one of my all-time favorite places to enjoy. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, making it the perfect spot to relax after a long day. The staff are incredibly friendly, they always greet you with a smile and make you feel welcome. Thanks for make my day: Sang, Dino, Jayce, Viktor, Tien !!!
The drinks are consistently great, with a good variety to choose from, and the bartenders really know their craft. Whether you're in the mood for a classic cocktail or something new, they never disappoint.
What makes this place even more special right now is the cozy Christmas Decor. The warm lights, festive ornaments, and subtle holiday touches create such a comforting, joyful vibe. It feels like stepping into a little holiday escape - perfect for enjoying good drinks and good company.
Highly recommended for anyone lookin laid-back bar with great service ❤️❤️❤️
